entries.rationale: v1.1 survivor calibration (2026-11-11): the flat SDE>=7 bar passed 31.6% of the proof run, so survivorship also requires a pink-noise MES rescore in tier A or B. The 5-sigma MAD clip has NO depth floor in this version — a known sensitivity defect (a 1.5% transit on a 0.3%-noise star scores lower than a 1.0% one); bulk_v2 fixes it. See bulk/CALIBRATION_V1_1.md.
Deep-pipeline thresholds as run since the 2026-11-13 BLS fix (SDE 8.5 discovery bar, 6.5 acceptance floor). Snapshot of hunter.py's named constants.
Gauntlet thresholds as vetted through S96-S98 (shape-gate V/U bounds, 15% chi2 floor, 10% MAD-clip floor). Snapshot of the gauntlet's named constants plus the stage-result decision policy.

Gauntlet calibration v2 (2026-11-14, Phase 1.2 A-4): carries the stage-result decision policy (raw-flux/parity bars, minimum-data bars, blend bars) and the waiver allowlist. v1's thresholds carried over unchanged; the policy values were hardcoded constants in gauntlet/stage_result.py before this version. Pre-merge correction (Phase 1.2 follow-up F-1, 2026-11-14): neighbour_search_radius_arcsec added at 180.0 — the vetting manual's 180 arcsecond rule; the code census defaulted to 60 arcseconds and missed a blend host at 66.5 arcseconds (S97, TIC 139524628). gauntlet_v2 never reached main, so this pre-merge edit updates the registry entry in the same commit rather than minting a v3.

Bulk calibration v2 (2026-11-14, Phase 1.2 B-2): fixes the v1 MAD-clip sensitivity defect (floor_10pct clip, same rule as the gauntlet) and hard-codes the per-sector systematic windows from the S96-S98 screens. All v1 thresholds carried over unchanged. See bulk/SENSITIVITY_MAP.md and bulk/CLIP_GRID_CRITERIA.md.

Bulk calibration v3 (2026-11-15, quality-mask fix): extends the screen quality mask to exclude TESS scattered-light flags bits 29/30 (quality_mask 1610629823 = lightkurve default 17087 + bits 29/30). The bulk_v2 rescore gauntlet found 18/25 NEW S96 leads were flagged-cadence artifacts — dips only in bit-29/30 cadences, zero clean cadences in transit. All v2 thresholds carried over unchanged.

External-tool configuration v1 (2026-11-15, Phase 2 2B): shared run settings (seed, timeout, memory cap) + per-tool venv paths and versions for LATTE and TRICERATOPS, + PROVISIONAL TRICERATOPS FPP/NFPP bars. The venv paths point at the Mac (/Volumes/NVME/...); on any host without them the tool stage reads UNMEASURED (missing_venv), never a crash. The FPP bars are PROVISIONAL — the Giacalone et al. 2021 validation bars (FPP < 0.015, NFPP < 0.001) and a 0.5 refute bar — and do not gate promotion until the Phase 2 vote ratifies them (see PHASE_2_PROGRESS.md, 2B/2C judgment call 3). P-10 (2026-11-15, pre-merge correction under the F-1 exception): added the full Giacalone et al. 2021 citation (AJ 161, 24, doi:10.3847/1538-3881/abc6af, arXiv:2002.00691) for the provisional FPP/NFPP bars; no threshold changed.

Deep calibration v2 (2026-11-15, quality-mask fix): extends the deep pipeline quality mask to exclude TESS scattered-light flags bits 29/30 (quality_mask 1610629823 = lightkurve default 17087 + bits 29/30). M-11 verified hunter.py was exposed the same way as the bulk screen (lightkurve default read keeps bits 29/30 on QLP targets). All v1 thresholds carried over unchanged.

External-tool configuration v2 (2026-11-15, Phase 3 P3-9): v1's run settings, venv paths, tool versions and TRICERATOPS bars carried over UNCHANGED, + the disposition policy (A) ratified by the unanimous Phase 3 vote (2026-11-15, TB-2) recorded explicitly: FPP <= 0.015 and NFPP <= 0.001 validate; FPP >= 0.5 refutes; without a contrast curve, intermediate results read INCONCLUSIVE, never 'validated'. The policy already behaved as (A) under v1 — v2 is a recording act, not a behaviour change. Evidence: C-10 runs on the Mac — EB TIC 308851365 FPP 0.999998 (refute, decisive) and WASP-29b TIC 183537452 FPP 0.169, NFPP 0.0, STP-dominated (0.160), no contrast curve (INCONCLUSIVE, not validated). The STP-excluded disposition (Gemini's LIKELY_PLANET_UNCONSTRAINED_STP) is NOT adopted in Phase 3 (TB-2); the known-planet panel (P3-9) is the evidence that could justify it in 3.1. Supersedes external_tools_v1 for all new tool runs.

Bulk calibration v4 (2026-11-16, Phase 3 P3-15 gate landing — ACTIVE; pre-merge update of the 2026-11-15 provisional scaffold under the F-1 exception: the profile never stamped a run and never reached main): all bulk_v3 gates carried over verbatim + the P3-14 grid-edge floor constants + the two tier-B gates adopted by the P3-11 decision (parent 2026-11-16, Amendment A approved): EPOCH-CLUSTER veto (P3-13 criterion: (P, T0) within 1% / 3 h, clusters >20 stars; tier-B members demoted, tier-A flagged) and TWO-COMBINED (2-event rows need both events strong AND mes_pink >= 9.0). Combined measured loss 0/16 in-regime, 1/412 overall; real survivors 4,692 -> 734, null floor 0.1085 -> 0.0196. PHASE-DEPTH held (degenerate oe=0.000); DEMOTE-SYS/DEMOTE-ALL rejected (6/7 pricing). SDE bars unchanged (bulk 7.0). Supersedes bulk_v3 for new screens.

Bulk calibration v5 (2026-11-18, post-merge fixes round 1 — ACTIVE): all bulk_v4 gates carried over verbatim + the SECTOR_EPOCH_CLUSTER veto extended to tier-A members (epoch_cluster_veto_tier_a: true; P3-13 criterion unchanged: (P, T0) within 1% / 3 h, clusters >20 stars). The S98 one-shot showed v4's flag-only treatment leaves 42.2% of the final queue in the 13.7 d band (210/498, 184 flagged tier-A cluster members). Measured effect on the frozen S98 run (read-only replay): queue 498 -> 314, M6 42.2% -> 8.3%, 0/11 recovered TOIs lost. systematic_windows unchanged (zero flagged rows below 13.5 d in S98). Supersedes bulk_v4 for new screens.

External-tool configuration v3 (2026-11-17, Phase 4 P4-8): v2's venv paths, tool versions, seed, memory cap, TRICERATOPS bars and disposition policy (A) carried over UNCHANGED; the only change is timeout_s 1800 -> 3600. Evidence: the P4-8 full nightly (Mac, 2026-11-17) measured healthy walls 164.9-549.8 s and healthy inits up to 467.9 s (warm cache), but the outage-era healthy init tail reached 1714.3 s (TIC 399571743) — a healthy run can exceed the 1800 s cap (init 1714 s + calc ~300 s = ~2014 s), so the v2 cap sits below the healthy tail. The 3600 s cap is 2x the old cap with headroom over the worst observed healthy run; the wrapper's init budget is 2400 s (P4-8). The runner cap remains the ultimate bound (the in-process SIGALRM budget does not enforce — the tool's per-sector try/except swallows it). Supersedes external_tools_v2 for all new tool runs.

Bulk calibration v6 (2026-11-20, bulk_v6 build, PIPE50 vote ref PIPE50-20261119 — ACTIVE): all bulk_v5 gates carried over verbatim + F-1 merge-time T0-cluster veto (few-event rows, T0-only union-find linkage, 3 h, clusters >20 stars; disposition DEMOTED_T0_CLUSTER) + B-1 K=3 join after the (P, T0) veto (restores the 32 tier-B pass-1 survivors lost on S97) + mask gating (mask only when pass-1 is contaminant-like: EB flag or depth > 1.0%) + stitched pass-1 recording default-on. F-1 evidence (NULL_DIAGNOSIS, PROVEN): 158/213 null finals T0-clustered. The 8.33/1,000 bound is KEPT. Supersedes bulk_v5 for new screens.
